description:
Update a new group by sending a json object of type 'group' as given in Models section as part of the Request Body. The group name in a project is unique. Labels can be applied on a group as part of creation.

If a group with the groupName specified in the URL already exists, then this call acts as an update.

This operation is Idempotent.
